topic: mnemo Auto-Dreamer-style committed benchmark as a static evidence/replay package

public_sources.note: PR 96 contains one unsigned feature commit; associated public CI/security runs are both completed with conclusion=failure.

static_recalculation.scope: Arithmetic consistency only; does not independently reproduce retrieval outcomes.

structural_intervention.consequence: All 72 active episodic memories in each fresh smoke-run trial share a tag, so the historical tag-overlap consolidator places them into one qualifying cluster and creates one semantic record while marking all originals Consolidated.
structural_intervention.post_record_semantics: The semantic record concatenates every original content and stores original IDs in metadata.consolidated_from; this structurally explains active-bank 72->1 for this scenario.
structural_intervention.interpretation_guard: This is an Auto-Dreamer-style shape benchmark, not evidence that a learned semantic consolidator independently discovered one optimal cluster.

missing_from_committed_result: ordered pre/post query result IDs/content hashes
input_provenance_gap.effect: The committed result permits reducer/arithmetic audit but not exact input-byte or retrieval-row replay.

audit_plane_gap.historical_behavior: Creates memory + consolidated_from relations and updates originals; no MemoryConsolidated AgentEvent is emitted by this function at the checked merge revision.
audit_plane_gap.current_behavior: Deterministic by-id topic-document consolidation that preserves member provenance and emits hash-chained MemoryConsolidated/MemoryRevised events.
audit_plane_gap.scope_guard: The newer sibling primitive cannot retroactively attest execution of the historical benchmark path.

recall_transcript_gap.historical_recall: Benchmark uses strategy=auto, limit=10, BENCH_TAG filter and NoopEmbedding; auto retrieval fuses vector/BM25/recency/graph then truncates.
recall_transcript_gap.event_behavior: Recall emits MemoryRead with run_id=None and payload containing query/results/strategy, but benchmark does not publish/export the event log or ordered returned IDs.
recall_transcript_gap.consequence: The reported 1/6 pre and 6/6 post recall can be read and aggregate-checked, but not independently row-replayed from the public package.

public_ci_status.scope_guard: Public CI does not independently validate the PR body's local green-build/test claims. Failure cause was not recovered here, so this does not show that the Auto-Dreamer benchmark itself failed or that its committed result is false.

mnemo_committed_benchmark_as_full_static.reason: Exact generated inputs, row-level ordered retrieval outputs and an execution-bound audit transcript are absent. The package is source+result bound and reducer-auditable, but not execution-complete; public CI on the feature head also failed and therefore does not independently attest the local smoke-run claim.

current_deterministic_consolidate_primit.reason: It provides deterministic member ordering, explicit provenance and hash-chained consolidation/revision events, but it is a different/current path from the historical smoke benchmark.

scope_limits: No benchmark binary was executed in this run.
No hosted runner, external model/API credit, paid quota or manual user execution was consumed.
GitHub commit verification authenticates the repository merge commit as reported by GitHub; it is not an independent attestation that the benchmark binary produced the committed result bytes.
The 72->1 structural explanation is exact for the checked smoke configuration/source path, not a general claim about mnemo or Auto-Dreamer.
CI failure is recorded only at workflow/job-step scope because the underlying failure log/annotation was not recovered.
